name: Saionji Mai
source:
A first-year student who is a member of the string orchestra club, and in charge of the piano. [url=/c32637]Nao's[/url] younger sister who is aiming to become a professional pianist. Mai has a cheerful, friendly and emotional personality and wears her heart on her sleeve.

Mai's piano performances are always praised and she has a colorful playstyle. In order to fulfill her dream, Mai is aiming to win the upcoming competition so she can study at a famous music school outseas. However, she finds the thought of having to live away from her older sister quite hard.

She is also friends with [url=/c34093]Ayami[/url], and often asks her to help with studying before tests. Mai also has a tendency to leave things at the last minute.
